interface.signature: def transform(A: str, B: str) -> int:

preconditions.description: Both input strings A and B must have at least one character.
The lengths of strings A and B must be equal; otherwise, transformation is impossible.

preconditions.expression: all(c in A for c in B)
preconditions.description: Every character in B must exist in A; otherwise, transformation is impossible.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and all(B[i] == A[(i - return_value) % len(A)] for i in range(len(B))))
postconditions.description: If transformation is impossible, return -1. Otherwise, return the minimum number of steps required to transform A into B, where each step moves a character from A to the front, and the resulting string matches B.
